reason: The real deterministic target-backed MTP request uses Q6_K N=4 and N=5 verification, but N=2/3/4 totals only 2.6467% of summed MTP GPU kernel duration and fails the predeclared 10% combined and 5% per-device gates. N=5 is the actual opportunity at 56.9103% by itself.

startup_and_request.note: Throughput is a workload witness, not a baseline/candidate performance claim.

attribution.dense_gemm: No hipBLAS/rocBLAS dense GEMM symbol is present in the request span; every joined Q6_K verification call is MMVQ, not MMQ or dense GEMM.

n5_boundary.interpretation: The current N=5 route is already narrow DP4A MMVQ with no padded WMMA columns. A successor must redesign N=5 work/row/column organization rather than merely force DP4A.

communication.warning: Direct-P2P kernels spin/synchronize and device dispatch durations may overlap; these shares are not wall-time communication fractions.

procedure_failures: rocprofv3 flushed complete profile and graph databases after SIGINT but did not terminate; the runner preserved the databases and ultimately killed both injected processes with return code -9.
The original fixed-width-WMMA premise did not match registered gfx1201: Q6_K N=2-5 already selects one-wave DP4A MMVQ.
The HIP backend receives shape/type but no MTP verification marker, so a local N=2-4 selector would also affect ordinary small batches.
follow_up: Do not build the proposed N=2-4 candidate for this nmax=4 workload. Freeze a separate N=5 source/ISA feasibility task that first designs a genuinely different DP4A work organization and an explicit MTP marker propagation strategy.
